name: ordinal_word
description: Render a numerical rank as an English ordinal word; matched control renders same rank as a cardinal word.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
ordinals='first second third fourth fifth sixth seventh eighth ninth tenth'.split()
cardinals='one two three four five six seven eight nine ten'.split()
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 n=i%10+1
 context=random.choice(['Race result','Queue position','List entry','Rank in the contest','Finishing position'])
 items.append({'prompt':f'{context}: {n}. Write this rank as an English ordinal word. Answer:', 'answer':' '+ordinals[n-1]})
 control.append({'prompt':f'{context}: {n}. Write this number as an English cardinal word. Answer:', 'answer':' '+cardinals[n-1]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
